claim: Generated migration guards are simulated against synthetic before/after datasets derived from the real public schema (tables drawn from ranked risks). Each guard is evaluated on four scenarios per table: a bounded-safe change it must allow, a broad change it must block, a missing-table case it must fail closed on, and an unknown-row-count case it must fail closed on. An effective guard scores 1.0; a no-op control guard that always allows scores strictly lower, proving the simulation discriminates.
